newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-TEAMS FOR 1860 MUNICH V BAYERN MUNICH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-TEAMS FOR 1860 MUNICH V BAYERN MUNICH.

text.p: Teams for Sunday's German first division match between 1860 Munich and Bayern Munich:
1860 - 12-Rainer Berg; 6-Bernhard Trares; 4-Marco Walker, 7-Horst Heldt, 15-Holger Greilich, 22-Matthias Hamann; 10-Peter Nowak, 20-Miroslav Stevic, 33-Manfred Bender; 13-Harald Cerny, 9-Olaf Bodden.

Bayern - 1-Oliver Kahn; 10-Lothar Matthaeus; 2-Markus Babbel, 5-Thomas Helmer, 17-Christian Ziege, 16-Dietmar Hamann; 6-Christian Nerlinger, 8-Thomas Strunz, 21-Alexander Zickler; 20-Ruggiero Rizzitelli, 18-Juergen Klinsmann.
